verdict.rationale: Supabase Storage is documented as a scalable file-management service with fine-grained access controls, using row-level security and custom policies for file permissions. It also offers 'optimized delivery' and on-the-fly image transformations for fast delivery via signed and public URLs. missing for 10: explicit evidence of CDN-backed delivery (only 'optimized delivery' is claimed), documented upload API/flow details, independent hands-on corroboration of storage access rules and delivery.
